rfc9421_appendix_b.json is copied unchanged from the .NET package's tests, at
https://github.com/51Degrees/51degrees-dotnet/blob/4d7152bfcb7c9bcb17d14cb512025b65a3307313/pipeline/Tests/AgentSignatureTests/Fixtures/rfc9421_appendix_b.json

It holds the six worked examples of Appendix B.2 of RFC 9421, HTTP Message
Signatures (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9421.txt). Each entry carries
the signature base, the Signature-Input header value and the Signature header
value the RFC prints for that example, with the public part of the Appendix
B.1 key the example uses. The RFC wraps its long lines using the convention of
RFC 8792, where a line ending in a backslash continues on the next line and
the leading whitespace of that next line is not part of the value. Every value
was unfolded by that rule, so the backslashes and the wrapping whitespace are
gone whilst the line breaks that belong to a signature base are kept.
